meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会在代理容器里安装 Vercel 命令行工具并配好访问凭据，之后可以直接把 Web 项目部署到 Vercel，也能查看部署列表或确认账号。
howto.when: 当用户想让代理把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会执行 vercel deploy 并输出部署地址。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署。
say.note: 会调用 vercel ls 查看部署列表。

say.text: 检查 Vercel 登录状态。
say.note: 会运行 vercel whoami 确认凭据有效。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude installs the Vercel CLI and credentials in the agent container, enabling it to deploy web apps to Vercel, list deployments, and check auth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs vercel deploy and shows the URL.
Calls vercel ls to fetch deployment list.
Runs vercel whoami to verify the token.
